summary: Nested 8x8 loop removing a value from a grid of array-like cells. Walks 64 cells in two nested do-while loops advancing the cell pointer by 9 dwords (36 bytes) per step, calling ArrayRemoveByValue(cell, a2) on each. After the grid sweep it makes one final ArrayRemoveByValue(this + 576, a2) call, where 576 dwords equals 64 cells x 9, i.e. the first element just past the grid, and returns that call's result.

local_names.this: grid object exposing 64 array-like cells at 9-dword stride

operations.description: Outer loop counter v3 runs 8 iterations over the grid rows
Inner loop counter v4 runs 8 iterations per outer pass, yielding 64 cells total
Cell pointer v2 advances by 9 dwords per inner iteration (36-byte stride between cells)
ArrayRemoveByValue(v2, a2) invoked once per cell to remove value a2
Final ArrayRemoveByValue(this + 576, a2) removes the value from the element 576 dwords past this, the first element after the 8x8 grid
Returns the result of the final ArrayRemoveByValue call
Invoked on the frame path by ShortComputation_f0d0 and StateDependentUpdateDispatch
